AZURE project work in PROGRESS STEP 1
=====================================

TO DELETE ALL ABOVE RESOURCES
============================
az group delete --name dbanking-rg --yes --no-wait

To Create RG using POWERSHELL COMMANDS
======================================
  
az group create `
 --name dbanking-rg `
 --location southindia
 
Running Main.Bicep
==================
Generating a random num using ASCII
==================================
$rand = -join ((97..122) | Get-Random -Count 5 | ForEach-Object {[char]$_})

az deployment group create `
  --resource-group dbanking-rg `
  --template-file infra/main.bicep `
  --parameters `
    baseName=dbanking `
	uniqueSuffix=$rand `
	sshPublicKey="ssh-rsa  itssa@Ahmed"


Generating random name using GUID
================================
$guid= ([guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N")).substring(0,6)

az deployment group create `
  --resource-group dbanking-rg `
  --template-file infra/main.bicep `
  --parameters `
    baseName=dbanking `
	uniqueSuffix=$guid `
	sshPublicKey="ssh-rsa  itssa@Ahmed"


Run main.bicep without GUID
===========================

az deployment group create `
  --resource-group dbanking-rg `
  --template-file infra/main.bicep `
  --parameters `
    baseName=dbanking `
    sshPublicKey="ssh-rsa  itssa@Ahmed"

====================================================================================

Authmode:"Key"
setx COSMOS_KEY ""
echo $env:COSMOS_KEY
dotnet build
dotnet run

Option 2
========

AuthMode:"ManagedIdentity"
az login
az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv
az cosmosdb sql role assignment create `
  --account-name dbankingcosmoskerhjw2iy4ptg `
  --resource-group dbanking-rg `
  --role-definition-name "Cosmos DB Built-in Data Contributor" `
  --principal-id f6acf69f-e510-41cd-adcc-485082ec01dc `
  --scope "/"
Remove-Item Env:COSMOS_KEY
setx COSMOS_KEY ""
dotnet build
dotnet run


Build Image locally
docker build -t finbanking-api:local .

tag image for ACR
docker tag finbanking-api:local dbankingacr.azurecr.io/finbanking-api:v1

Login to ACR
az acr login --name dbankingacr


Push Image to ACR
docker push dbankingacr.azurecr.io/finbanking-api:v1


Attach ACR to AKS
az aks update `
  --resource-group dbanking-rg `
  --name dbanking-aks `
  --attach-acr dbankingacr

GET AKS Credentials
az aks get-credentials `
  --resource-group dbanking-rg `
  --name dbanking-aks `
  --overwrite-existing

Get KUBELET MI
$KUBELET_ID = az aks show `
  --resource-group dbanking-rg `
  --name dbanking-aks `
  --query identityProfile.kubeletidentity.objectId `
  -o tsv

Grant COSMOS DB RAC
$ROLE_ID = az cosmosdb sql role definition list `
  --account-name dbankingcosmoskerhjw2iy4ptg `
  --resource-group dbanking-rg `
  --query "[?roleName=='Cosmos DB Built-in Data Contributor'].id" `
  -o tsv

az cosmosdb sql role assignment create `
  --account-name dbankingcosmoskerhjw2iy4ptg `
  --resource-group dbanking-rg `
  --scope "/" `
  --principal-id $KUBELET_ID `
  --role-definition-id $ROLE_ID
  
 az aks get-credentials `
  --resource-group dbanking-rg `
  --name dbanking-aks `
  --overwrite-existing


 Finbanking-deployment.yaml
 
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: finbanking-api
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: finbanking-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: finbanking-api
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: finbanking-api
        image: dbankingacr.azurecr.io/finbanking-api:v1
        env:
        - name: COSMOS_ENDPOINT
          value: "https://dbankingcosmoskerhjw2iy4ptg.documents.azure.com:443/"
        - name: COSMOS_DATABASE
          value: "dbanking"
        - name: COSMOS_CONTAINER
          value: "accounts"
        - name: AuthMode
          value: "ManagedIdentity"
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80


Deploy API
kubectl apply -f finbanking-deployment.yaml


Wait for POD
kubectl wait --for=condition=available deployment/finbanking-api


Finbanking-service.yaml

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: finbanking-api-svc
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  selector:
    app: finbanking-api
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 8080


Create Loadbalancer Service
kubectl apply -f finbanking-service.yaml


Get external IP
kubectl get svc finbanking-api-svc


Test
<external IP>/swagger/index.html
